scripts.dev: node scripts/auto-clean.mjs && npm run build -w shared && node scripts/start-dev.mjs
scripts.build: node scripts/auto-clean.mjs && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w shared && npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint:oxlint
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w shared && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w shared && npm run test -w client && npm run test -w server
scripts.tauri:dev: node scripts/auto-clean.mjs && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: node scripts/auto-clean.mjs && npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && tauri build --no-sign
